# `NetworkConnectionType`

Gets or sets the type of network connection used between the client and server. The network connection type information passed on to the server helps the server tune several parameters based on the network connection type.


## Type

```csharp
RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms.Configuration.NetworkConnectionType
```

## Used By

- [FreeRdpConfiguration](/api/reference/royalapps-community-freerdp-winforms-configuration-freerdpconfiguration)

[View source](https://github.com/royalapplications/royalapps-community-freerdp/blob/main/src/RoyalApps.Community.FreeRdp.WinForms/Configuration/NetworkConnectionType.cs#L8)

## Values

### `NotSpecified = 0`


Network connection type is not specified. The default value of wfreerdp.exe is used.
